title: Residential Leave and Licence Agreement (11 Months) with Security Deposit & Revocation Clauses
whenToUse: Use when executing a standard 11-month residential leave and licence agreement, ensuring that only a personal permissive licence is granted without creating any tenancy rights.
variantComparisonNote: Standard 11-month transactional licence deed under Section 52 Easements Act. Distinct from statutory tenancy lease deeds and eviction notices.
youWillNeed: Property title documents, electricity meter numbers, PAN and Aadhaar of Licensor and Licensee, police verification forms.
legalBasis: Section 52 Indian Easements Act, 1882; Indian Contract Act, 1872; Associated Hotels of India Ltd. v. R.N. Kapoor (1959).
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Strict grant of permissive personal licence under Section 52 Easements Act without creating estate/tenancy
Explicit 11-month term with lock-in period and notice of termination
Interest-free refundable security deposit terms and deductions clause
Licensor's absolute right of inspection, revocation, and re-entry

particulars.label: Licensor / Owner Name
particulars.description: Full name of legal owner / licensor

aiBlocks.title: Grant of Licence, 11-Month Term & Monthly Fee
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft clause granting purely personal permissive licence for 11 months for premises {{FACT:licensed_premises_address}} at ₹{{FACT:monthly_licence_fee}}/- per month, expressly disclaiming tenancy.

aiBlocks.title: Security Deposit & Utility Responsibilities
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft interest-free refundable security deposit clause, electricity/water payment duties, society maintenance fees, and inspection rights.

aiBlocks.title: Termination, Lock-In & Handover Covenants
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft 1-month termination notice, lock-in period, automatic termination on expiry, and liquidated damages of ₹2,000/- per day for unlawful overstay.
